subject: Live Misses You!
author: ZombieTron
body:
Or at least I miss you on Live!

I had a bit of depressing time on Halo 3 last night, which I wouldn't have bothered with if you were in Paradise City!! 🙁 It was OK in the end tho, cos Xan and I jumped to Burnout and beat my PB on a 2 player challenge which cheered me up! 🙂

Glad you arrived safe and sound, shame about the leg room on the plane tho! Maybe you will get bumped up to business on the way back to blighty! ✈️
